description: Blank leaves added at the front and rear of a textblock to protect the body of the work and to anchor the boards. Treated as a structural part of the binding rather than mere flyleaves, the better forms fold in a zigzag so each leaf opens fully and absorbs the pull of the cover.
name: end paper
